title: Communication Dated December 24, 1934, From Austrian Consulate-General, Tokyo, Re Mrs. L. Adamek-Pehterewa

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch.
SECRET REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY. 6378 Date January 10, 1935）
Subject Communication dated 24-12-34 from Austrian Consulate-General, Tokyo, re: Mrs. L. Adamek-Pehtereva.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by （手写签名）

With reference to the endorsement of D.C. (Special Branch) on the attached report dated January 5, 1935, on the subject of Mrs. L. Adamek-Pehtereva, further enquiries elicit the following information:-

Lydia Pehtereva, Russian, was born on July 12, 1906, at Harbin. She studied medicine in Europe and obtained her doctor's degree at the University of Vienna in 1929, after which she returned to Harbin where her parents resided. While in Harbin she married an Austrian named Adamek on August 17, 1930. On August 21 of the same year she obtained from the Austrian Consulate-General at Mukden passport No. 734924 good for travelling to all countries of Europe, America and Asia.

On May 10, 1931, she arrived in Shanghai from Harbin (?) and put up at the Astor House. In August of the same year she applied at the Health Department, S.M.C., for registration and gave her office address as 267 Kiangse Road. Her application was approved by the Shanghai Medical Board on November 17. On November 18, 1931, she removed to No. 587 Bubbling Well Road, Ascot Apartments.

Some time ago the Health Department, S.M.C., was informed by Dr. A. Miorini that Dr. Adamek-Pehtereva had left Shanghai for good in 1932. No communication to this effect has been received by the Health Department from her nor have any enquiries been received from other places regarding her qualifications. Her name still appears on the list of medical practitioners registered with the Shanghai Municipal Council with the address No. 587 Bubbling Well Road.

Dr. A. Miorini, residing at No. 934 Bubbling Well Road, interviewed by the undersigned on January 3, 1935, stated that

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 2，特科。
秘密报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 REGISTRY. 6378 日期 1935年1月10日）
事由：关于 L. Adamek-Pehtereva 女士，东京奥地利总领事馆 1934年12月24日来函。
由 D.S.I. Prokofiev 撰写。转发人 （手写签名）

鉴于副督察（特科）在附后的 1935年1月5日关于 L. Adamek-Pehtereva 女士的报告上的批注，经进一步查询，获得如下信息：-

Lydia Pehtereva，俄国人，1906年7月12日出生于哈尔滨。她在欧洲学习医学，并于 1929 年在维也纳大学获得博士学位，之后返回父母居住的哈尔滨。在哈尔滨期间，她于 1930年8月17日与一名名为 Adamek 的奥地利人结婚。同年8月21日，她从奥地利驻奉天总领事馆获得第 734924 号护照，该护照适用于前往欧洲、美洲和亚洲所有国家。

1931年5月10日，她从哈尔滨（？）抵达上海，入住礼查饭店（Astor House）。同年8月，她向工部局卫生处申请注册，并提供其办公地址为江西路 267 号。她的申请于 11月17日获得上海医务委员会批准。1931年11月18日，她迁至静安寺路 587 号阿斯科特公寓（Ascot Apartments）。

不久前，工部局卫生处收到 A. Miorini 医生的通知，称 Adamek-Pehtereva 医生已于 1932 年永久离开上海。卫生处未收到她本人的任何此类通知，也未收到其他地方关于其资质的查询。她的名字仍出现在上海公共租界工部局注册的执业医师名单上，地址为静安寺路 587 号。

居住在静安寺路 934 号的 A. Miorini 医生于 1935年1月3日接受下文签署人问询时 stated that

he had received the information regarding Mrs. Adamek-Pehtereva's
departure from Shanghai from Mr. A. Costenoble, who, he knew,
was in touch with her.
Inquiries at Brandt Rogers, Ltd., 361 Kiangse Road,
who are agents for the Ascot Apartments, show that the name of
Mrs. Adamek-Pehtereva does not appear in the company's register
of tenants in the Ascot Apartments. There are good reasons
to believe, however, that she shared flat 401 with Mr. A.
Costenoble who occupied that flat from November 18, 1931 till
July, 1932.
Mr. A. Costenoble of Ahlers & Co., 264 Kiangse Road,
was interviewed on January 4 and 9, 1935. He states that
Mrs. Adamek-Pehtereva left Shanghai for Harbin some time during
the latter part of 1932, and that, as far as he knows, she
subsequently resided for various periods in Harbin and Tsingtao
and also visited Hongkong. She was in Shanghai for a few days
in spring of 1933 when she resided at the Imperial Hotel, 941
Bubbling Well Road. Further, Mr. Costenoble states that she
was divorced some time ago, after which she married Mr. Fihely,
British subject, who is believed to be a port doctor in Hongkong.
In August, 1934, when Mrs. Fihely was in Shanghai en-route from
Hongkong to Japan she visited Mr. Costenoble and asked him to
forward certain documents to her c/o Nippon Yusen Kaisha, Kobe,
which he did. On that occasion she said that her father was
dead. Mr. Costenoble is unable or unwilling to state when
and where Mrs. Adamek-Pehtereva was married to Dr. Fihely.
Enquiries at the local office of the Nippon Yusen
Kaisha show that Mrs. J.P. Fihely, 28, British, was among the
through passengers from Hongkong to Kobe, Japan, on board the

他关于 Adamek-Pehtereva 女士离开上海的信息是从 A. Costenoble 先生处得知的，据他所知，Costenoble 先生与她有联系。
向江西路 361 号的 Brandt Rogers, Ltd. 公司查询，该公司是阿斯科特公寓的代理商，结果显示 Adamek-Pehtereva 女士的名字并未出现在该公司阿斯科特公寓的租户登记册中。然而，有充分理由相信，她与 A. Costenoble 先生合租 401 室，Costenoble 先生从 1931年11月18日至 1932年7月期间居住在该公寓。
供职于江西路 264 号 Ahlers & Co. 公司的 A. Costenoble 先生于 1935年1月4日和9日接受问询。他表示，Adamek-Pehtereva 女士于 1932 年下半年某时离开上海前往哈尔滨，并且据他所知，她随后在哈尔滨和青岛断续居住过一段时间，还曾访问香港。1933 年春，她在上海停留数日，期间居住在静安寺路 941 号帝国饭店（Imperial Hotel）。此外，Costenoble 先生表示，她不久前离婚，随后嫁给了英国籍 Fihely 先生，据信他是香港的一名港口医生。1934年8月，Fihely 太太从香港途经上海前往日本时拜访了 Costenoble 先生，并请他将某些文件转寄给她，收件人为神户日本邮船会社（Nippon Yusen Kaisha）转交，他照办了。当时她说她父亲已去世。Costenoble 先生无法或不愿说明 Adamek-Pehtereva 女士是何时何地与 Fihely 医生结婚的。
向日本邮船会社本地办事处查询显示，J.P. Fihely 太太，28岁，英国人，是乘坐

s.s. [此处转录不清], which left Hong Kong on August 9, 1934. She gave her home address as 23 Lyemun (?) Building, Hongkong, and her address in Japan as c/c N.Y.K., Kobe. Further it was ascertained that Dr. J.P. Finely, 42, British, travelled from Hongkong to [此处转录不清] in the s.s. [此处转录不清], which was in this port on October 6, 1934. He gave his home address as c/o Port Health Office, Hongkong, and his address in Japan as c/o N.Y.K. Yokohama. Dr. J.P. and Mrs. Lydia Fehilly returned to Hongkong from Japan in the s.s. [此处转录不清], which was in this port on October 21, 1934. They gave their address in Japan as Oriental Hotel, Kobe, and their home address as c/o Port Health Office, Hongkong, of which Dr. Fihely is an employee.

From the above it would appear that Mr. Costenoble's information regarding Mrs. Adamek-Pehtereva having been married to Dr. J.P. Fihely is correct.

The local Austrian Consulate-General was visited, but no further information could be obtained, with the exception of the fact that on March 29, 1934, Dr. Adamek-Pehtereva's diploma had been certified at the Consulate and handed over to Mr. Costenoble against receipt for forwarding to the owner, while her Austrian passport is still at the Consulate. Regarding her divorce and subsequent marriage to Dr. Fihely, the Consulate has no information apart from that received from Mr. Costenoble.

It is reported that Mrs. Adamek-Pehtereva was on the whole not successful in her professional capacity in Shanghai, that she often was in financial difficulties and incurred debts. It is also reported that she had a trouble with one of her patients in connection with an unsuccessful facial operation performed by her.

（左侧手写批注：）
C. P.
For favour
of instructions.
I am doubtful
about the
wisdom of

Consul Jobin
information about
the whereabouts
of Mrs. L. Adamek
Pehtereva as
she has ceased
to be an Austrian
subject and as
the request for
particulars
proved probably
some time ago.
The local Austrian
Consulate;

D. C. (Special Branch).
G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

轮船 [此处转录不清] 从香港前往日本神户的直达乘客之一，该轮于 1934年8月9日离开香港。她提供的家庭住址为香港 Lyemun (?) 大楼 23 号，在日本的地址为神户日本邮船会社转交。此外，经查实，J.P. Finely 医生，42岁，英国人，乘坐轮船 [此处转录不清] 从香港前往 [此处转录不清]，该轮于 1934年10月6日抵达本港。他提供的家庭住址为香港港口卫生局转交，在日本的地址为横滨日本邮船会社转交。J.P. 医生和 Lydia Fehilly 太太于 1934年10月21日乘坐轮船 [此处转录不清] 从日本返回香港，该轮当日抵达本港。他们提供的在日本的地址为神户东方饭店（Oriental Hotel），家庭住址为香港港口卫生局转交，Fihely 医生是该局的雇员。

综上所述，Costenoble 先生关于 Adamek-Pehtereva 女士已与 J.P. Fihely 医生结婚的信息似乎是正确的。

已走访本地奥地利总领事馆，但除以下事实外，未能获得更多信息：1934年3月29日，Adamek-Pehtereva 医生的文凭在领事馆经过认证，并凭收据交给 Costenoble 先生以便转交给所有者，而她的奥地利护照仍在领事馆。关于她的离婚及随后与 Fihely 医生的婚姻，领事馆除了从 Costenoble 先生处收到的信息外，没有其他信息。

据报道，Adamek-Pehtereva 女士在上海的职业表现总体并不成功，她经常陷入财务困境并欠下债务。另有报告称，她因一次失败的面部手术而与一名患者发生纠纷。

Date January 5, 19 35.

Subject (in full) Communication dated December 24, 1934, from Austrian
Consulate-General, Tokyo, re: Mrs. L. Adamek-Pehterewa.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J B Ross D.

Enquiries show that Mrs. Lidya Adamek-Pehteroff,
Austrian by marriage, Medical practitioner, left Shanghai for Harbin
either in 1932 or 1933. Her last known address in Shanghai
was No. 587 Bubbling Well Road, Ascot Apartments.
It is reported that some time ago she was divorced
and subsequently married to one Mr. Fenily (?), who is believed
to be a port doctor in Hongkong.
It is also reported that in August, 1934, she arrived
in Shanghai from Hongkong en-route to Japan and gave her address
in Japan as c/o Nippon Yusen Kaisha agents in Kobe.

A Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

52.
An effort should be made to get
more definite information. How long
did she live at No. 587 Bubbling Well Road
and who were her friends while there? To
where was her correspondence forwarded
after she left that address? Did she
register with the Health Dept. as a medical
practitioner and has the H. D. received any
inquiry from other places about her qualifications?
Are her friends here known to the Health Department?
To whom did she give her address as c/o
Nippon Yusen Kaisha, Kobe?

（左侧竖写批注：D.S.I. Prokofiev Jan 7）
（右下签名及日期：JAN. 7 1935）

事由（全称） 关于 L. Adamek-Pehterewa 女士，东京奥地利总领事馆 1934年12月24日来函。
由 D.S.I. Prokofiev 撰写。转发人 J B Ross D.

查询显示，Lidya Adamek-Pehteroff 太太，因婚姻取得奥地利国籍，执业医师，于 1932 或 1933 年离开上海前往哈尔滨。她在上海的最后一个已知地址是静安寺路 587 号阿斯科特公寓。
据报道，她不久前离婚，随后嫁给一位名为 Fenily (?) 的先生，据信他是香港的一名港口医生。
另据报道，1934年8月，她从香港抵达上海，途经上海前往日本，并提供其在日本的地址为神户日本邮船会社代理商转交。

A Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. (特科).

52.
应努力获取
更确切的信息。她
在静安寺路 587 号
居住了多久？在那期间
她的朋友有哪些？她离开
该地址后，信件被转寄到
何处？她是否在卫生处
注册为执业医师？卫生处
是否收到过其他地方关于
其资质的查询？卫生处是否
知晓她在本地的朋友？她将
神户日本邮船会社转交的
地址提供给了谁？

（左侧竖写批注：D.S.I. Prokofiev 1月7日）
（右下签名及日期：1935年1月7日）

Dear Sir:-

I would appreciate it very much if you
could kindly let me know the present address of
the above mentioned lady, who is Doctor of Medi-
zine and was living for some time at the Astor
House in Shanghai and working in cosmetics.

As there is an important matter involved
and letters of this Consulate addressed to her
father, Mr. Pechterew, Garnisonnaya 12, with the
request of informing this Consulate of the address
of his daughter, continue to remain unanswered,
I would be very much obliged for a reply at your
earliest convenience.

Apologizing for the trouble and thanking
you in anticipation,

I am, Dear Sir,
Yours very truly

**〔签名〕**
Vice-Consul

尊敬的先生：-

如蒙告知上述女士的现住址，我将不胜感激。她是医学博士，曾在上海礼查饭店居住一段时间，并从事化妆品工作。

由于此事涉及重要事项，且本领事馆致其父亲 Pechterew 先生（地址：Garnisonnaya 12）要求其告知女儿地址的信件一直未获回复，如能尽早赐复，我将深表感激。

对给您带来的麻烦表示歉意，并预先致谢，

此致，
敬礼
